svg.title: Reforestation Planning Map: where to plant trees after fires and hurricanes
svg.desc: Reforestation Planning Map: where to plant trees after fires and hurricanes. Finds and ranks U.S. Forest Service land that needs replanting, for nonprofits and volunteers. Scores 30 m cells on six factors from public federal and satellite data, then groups them into zones. 851 zones (~72,000 acres) in Plumas NF, CA, plus 6 after Hurricane Helene. Weights: untested heuristics. Status: working prototype · not public yet.
